questions.question: One should keep promises, ——?
questions.explanation: If "one" is the subject, the tag pronoun remains "one".

questions.question: He'd finished the work, ——?
questions.explanation: "He'd + V3" is the contraction for "had" (past perfect), so the tag uses "hadn't he".

questions.question: He used to play, ——?
questions.explanation: Both "didn't he" and "usedn't he" are correct tag questions for "used to".

questions.question: You must go now, ——?
questions.explanation: When "must" expresses necessity/obligation, "needn't" is used in the tag.

questions.question: We needed more time to finish the project, ___________?
questions.explanation: The main clause uses simple past 'needed', so the tag requires 'did' in negative form: 'didn't we'.
